label: D1 after an unrewarded visit to S1
explanation: Fires almost only at D1 (96% of mass), when the reward input is 0 and the previous trial reached S1. It never fires when the reward input is 1, and never at D1 after an unrewarded S2 visit (0 activations). The predicate uses only observed history. Dev: P 0.77, R 0.70, F1 0.73, mass recall 0.79. Most missed mass is on the window first trial D1, where prev_state is unknown inside the window; allowing prev_state != 2 raises mass recall to 0.96 but drops precision to 0.64. Magnitude builds over runs of consecutive unrewarded trials (examples go 0.5 -> 0.9 -> 1.0, and the top activation quartile is mostly preceded by two unrewarded trials). Activation is also stronger late in the episode and when the value is low (value < 7.7). The weak remainder is small D2 activations when S1 is reached. It reads as an S1-is-bad / evidence-for-S2 signal at D1.
